title: Polynomial-time reduction adapter
statement: Let two encoded maximization problems and a rational number $\delta$ be given. An adapter consists of polynomial-time maps reducing instances and recovering assignments, such that well-formed E3-Lin instances map to well-formed E3-Sat instances; feasible E3-Sat solutions recover to feasible E3-Lin solutions; an E3-Lin optimum of at least $1-\delta$ implies an E3-Sat optimum of at least $1-\delta$; and any E3-Sat solution of value at least $7/8+\delta$ recovers to an E3-Lin solution of value at least $1/2+\delta$.
